name: Ōwani (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ōwani town emblem in white: a ring of concentric arcs bearing a horizontal band with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ōwani, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1964.

features.role: Ōwani town emblem — a ring of concentric arcs bearing a horizontal band with a stylised character
